name: Relationships: expanding starts no job
why: The header delegate no longer calls _relAjBegin(), so no card opens.

name: Relationships: the progress stash is never written
why: The card would sum nothing and read 0 / 0.

name: Relationships: the job never finishes
why: The drain does not close the record, so the card says Running forever.

name: Relationships: an idle hover shows a card
why: Defensive guard, recorded as not testable: this provider is registered only when its first job starts (_relAjBegin() / _msToggleLengthPrecision()), so before that an idle hover finds no provider at all and shows the toggle's own tooltip whatever snapshot() answers. The spec's idle check pins the user-visible property; this guard only matters if registration ever moves earlier.

name: ⏱: the job never finishes
why: The finally block no longer closes the record.

name: ⏱: batch progress is not reported
why: The progress callback stops updating the card's counters.
